synopsis: Cognata is described as a commercial, large-scale ADAS/AV simulation platform adapted from road applications for construction and mining, with digital twins, scenes, sensors and scenario execution [f8971, f8410, f8685]. Its marketed off-road use case covers slopes, boulders, dust, vegetation, darkness and heavy-machine blind spots; it also advertises camera, radar, lidar and thermal simulation, custom sensors and assets, and machine-learning training compressed to months [f8411, f8413, f8412]. However, the listed construction/mining evidence is only a vendor use-case page: named current customers, independent correlation results and independent heavy-machine automatic-braking validation were not found [f8686, f8414, f8415, f8289]. The corpus includes Cognata among complete or near-complete platforms and highest-cost example tool chains, but public pricing, a numbered or latest release, and verified interfaces and standards remain unavailable or unverified [f8346, f9303, f8975, f8416, f8976, f8974]. Cognata reportedly remained independent as of 2025 and had partnerships with Ansys and Microsoft in January 2025 [f8417].
